title: Safe one-invocation GMGN wallet-stats batch response cardinality diagnostic
objective: Issue exactly one manual read-only GMGN official API 30d stats CLI invocation for the first 20 hash-verified valid unique Solana wallets and persist only an allowlisted structural/cardinality summary. Determine whether a 20-wallet request returns identity-addressable records for all requested wallets or only a subset, without storing or displaying addresses, identities, raw payload, raw stdout/stderr, credentials, or proxy URLs. Fail closed before network on hash/selection mismatch, PARK if GMGN_API_KEY is absent, and register a separate zero-network audit.
forbidden_actions: Do not exceed one GMGN CLI invocation or one physical provider request. Do not retry, paginate, auto-fill, use concurrency, or query any period other than 30d.
Do not call Helius, Chain.fm APIs, Dune, RPC, browser automation, web scraping, GMGN web pages, third-party providers, or fallback.
Do not read, display, persist, or forward GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY. Stats authentication is API-key-only and API-key presence may be recorded only as a Boolean.

Do not print, persist, or commit plaintext wallet addresses, labels, identity values, credentials, proxy URLs, credential URLs, raw provider payloads, raw stdout/stderr, token or transaction identifiers, counterparties, arbitrary provider keys, or complete exceptions.
Do not modify the wallet-stats parser behavior in this diagnostic task.
Do not overwrite historical output or claim that full-batch recovery is complete.
